task: Behaviour: TimeValue::read() of a '-00:MM'/'-00MM' timezone offset derived the minute sign from tzHour<0 (false for -0), silently dropping the negative sign; feature/correctness fix using the raw offset string's sign. Library change single file src/value.cpp (+ test).
